The 99 Names of Allah, also known as Asma-ul-Husna (أسماء الله الحسنى), are the names and attributes by which Muslims regard God in Islam. These names signify God's supreme and unparalleled nature and encompass His mercy, power, wisdom, and majesty attributes. Each name describes a different aspect of God's essence and attributes.

99 Names of Allah with Meaning
